detail.problem: extraction target has no anchor; its value cannot be relocated on a fresh page

detail.reason: I reached the correct book — the product page for 'The Grand Design' by Stephen Hawking (ASIN B004266K2A, categorised under Science / Astronomy & Space Science / Cosmology) — but this storefront (Amazon US) never publishes a tax-inclusive price. The page states only pre-tax amounts: Kindle $4.99, Hardcover $6.49–$14.54, Paperback $6.10–$10.83, Audible list $8.99 and a 'Buy -12% $11.03' box. Sales tax on Amazon is calculated per delivery address at checkout, so there is no 'price including tax' field to read, and no node next to such a label to record for replay. Reporting one of the above figures as the tax-inclusive price would be fabrication, so I stopped rather than record a misleading extraction.
detail.blocking: No tax-inclusive price is displayed anywhere on the product page. Obtaining one would require proceeding into checkout with a delivery address (and a signed-in account), which is a purchase-path action I should not take unprompted. Please confirm either (a) which pre-tax price/format you want recorded, or (b) that entering checkout to surface the tax total is authorised — or point me at the catalogue that exposes a 'Price (incl. tax)' field, if this goal was written for a different store.
